test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 02 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the following sentence.**

Listening to the news of the father's __illness,__ Soumen left for home with a heavy heart.
solution:
The correct answer is **sickness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Illness: **the state of being physically or mentally ill. (शारीरिक या मानसिक बीमारी)
 
• **Sickness: **the state of being ill. (बीमारी, रोग, रुग्‍णावस्‍था)
 
• Thus, the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in t
